summary: Renders a 4-point sparkle/star graphic. Guards on the enabled flag at this+0x04. Reads the rotation mode (this+0x10) and current angle (this+0x14), steps the angle toward the target angle (this+0x18) by the speed ratio (this+0x1C)/(this+0x20), handling 360-degree wraparound. Converts the stepped angle to radians (v32 = angle * 0.01745433), computes the sparkle extent from this+0x44 and this+0x48, derives four vertex positions around the center (this+0x3C, this+0x40), and draws each vertex with sub_553650 using color-coded parameters, returning the last draw result.

local_names.v13: normalized extent ratio used for vertex offsets
local_names.v22: vertex coordinate for the first sparkle point

operations.description: If the enabled flag at this+0x04 is zero, return zero immediately (render skipped).

Clockwise mode (this+0x10 == 0): step the current angle this+0x14 toward the target this+0x18 by subtracting (this+0x1C)/(this+0x20) times the wrap-corrected angular delta, choosing the 360-degree complement based on the comparison flags.
Counterclockwise mode (this+0x10 == 1): step the current angle this+0x14 by adding (this+0x1C)/(this+0x20) times the wrap-corrected angular delta to the target this+0x18.
Convert the stepped angle to radians: v32 = angle * 0.01745433.
Compute the sparkle extent: v30 = sqrt( (this+0x44 * (this+0x44/2)/2) + (this+0x48 * (this+0x48/2)/2) ), then the normalized ratio v13 = (this+0x44/2) / v30.

Convert the intermediate values with FloatConvertWrapper and CRTFtol, deriving four integer vertex positions around the center (this+0x3C, this+0x40) from the angle, the extent and sine/cosine of the radian value.
Draw the four sparkle vertices with sub_553650 (vertex indices 0..3, color-coded RGB parameters, final argument -1); return the last call's result.
